steps.en: Reduction only runs after validation passes
steps.id: Pengurangan hanya jalan setelah validasi lolos

steps.en: The notice's amount payable is set to the reduced amount
steps.id: Amount payable notice diubah menjadi jumlah hasil pengurangan

steps.en: The reduced amount is also set on the online side
steps.id: Jumlah hasil pengurangan juga diubah di sisi online
steps.why_en: The online copy is skipped silently when missing, and the two data stores are not guaranteed to commit together.
steps.why_id: Salinan online dilewati diam-diam bila tidak ada, dan kedua penyimpanan data tidak dijamin commit bersamaan.

steps.en: A repeat request on a reduced notice is applied as asked
steps.id: Request berulang pada notice yang sudah dikurangi diterapkan sesuai permintaan
steps.why_en: A notice already reduced is answered as done without applying the newly requested amount.
steps.why_id: Notice yang sudah dikurangi dijawab selesai tanpa menerapkan jumlah yang baru diminta.
